title: Vocabulary 실전 문제

questions.sectionInstructionKo: Vocabulary 실전 문제 하나를 누르거나 빈칸 말만 쓰세요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: ④ natural. in front of : behind가 반의어이므로 artificial의 반의어 natural. (답지 p.36 Vocabulary 실전 01)
questions.promptEn:
Choose the word that completes the analogy.

in front of : behind = artificial : ______

questions.sectionInstructionKo: Vocabulary 실전 문제 하나를 누르거나 빈칸 말만 쓰세요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: ⑤ made. make a decision은 '결정을 내리다'. (답지 p.36 Vocabulary 실전 02)
questions.promptEn:
Choose the best word for the blank.

After talking with my parents, I ______ a decision to change schools.

questions.sectionInstructionKo: Vocabulary 실전 문제 하나를 누르거나 빈칸 말만 쓰세요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: recipe. 음식을 만드는 방법에 대한 설명. (답지 p.36 Vocabulary 실전 03)
questions.promptEn:
Write the word that matches the definition. It starts with r.

instructions for making food
→ r______

questions.sectionInstructionKo: Vocabulary 실전 문제 하나를 누르거나 빈칸 말만 쓰세요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: copy. 베끼다, 모방하다; 복사하다. (답지 p.36 Vocabulary 실전 04)
questions.promptEn:
Write the word that fits both blanks.

Don't try to ______ my answers during the test. The teacher is watching.
I want to ______ this file to keep the original safe.

questions.sectionInstructionKo: Vocabulary 실전 문제 하나를 누르거나 빈칸 말만 쓰세요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: ① offers, ⑤ supplies. provide는 give, offer, supply와 바꿔 쓸 수 있다. (답지 p.36 Vocabulary 실전 05)
questions.promptEn:
Choose every word that can replace the underlined word.

The hotel <u>provides</u> free breakfast for its guests.

questions.sectionInstructionKo: Vocabulary 실전 문제 하나를 누르거나 빈칸 말만 쓰세요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: ③. take a look at은 '~을 한 번 보다, ~을 살펴보다'이지 '~을 찾다'가 아니다. (답지 p.37 Vocabulary 실전 06)
questions.promptEn:
Choose the sentence whose Korean gloss of the underlined words is NOT correct.

① She <u>came up with</u> a good idea for the class project. (생각해 냈다)
② Fruits <u>such as</u> apples and bananas are good for health. (~와 같은)
③ Let's <u>take a look at</u> the new comic book. (~을 찾다)
④ He finished the homework <u>by himself</u>. (혼자서)
⑤ TV <u>stands for</u> television. (~을 의미하다)
choices: She came up with a good idea for the class project. (생각해 냈다)
Fruits such as apples and bananas are good for health. (~와 같은)
Let's take a look at the new comic book. (~을 찾다)
He finished the homework by himself. (혼자서)

questions.sectionInstructionKo: Vocabulary 실전 문제 하나를 누르거나 빈칸 말만 쓰세요.
questions.explainKo: 정답: unlock. 잠긴 것을 열다. (답지 p.37 Vocabulary 실전 07)
questions.promptEn:
Complete the sentence with the word that matches the definition.

to open something that is locked

I forgot the key, so I couldn't ______ the door.

introKo: 통과 80%. Vocabulary 실전 문제. 고르기는 누르고, 빈칸은 그 칸의 말만 쓰세요.
